notes: My collection has a new look at the top: what your collection is worth now, a value chart you can drag across (1W to 1Y and All), and your most valuable cards beside it.
New Performance tab: how much you're up or down on the cards where you entered what you paid.
Your cards can show as pictures or as the list (Pictures or List, next to Sort by).
Price history is now kept for 13 months instead of 4, so the chart can go back a year.
